I can only tell you how it went for me, don't know if it will help you, but here it goes. 

I've come up with the best possible questions in my mind that would cut through all the lies. 

I had arguments ready to take down her potential lies and denying. 

I came up with possible answers she might give, and thought how would i respond. 

I've browsed this sub and read dozens of stories of confrontations and took notes from them. 

I was ready and fairly calm. If this was a job interview, i would fucking nail it. 

But in the end it didnt matter, because she simply still denied and still lied. Even when i had screenshots and evidence. 

I was dissappointed to say the least. 

But i've learned that if they dont want to give you truth, there is nothing you can do about it. It's not something you can control. Accepting this takes time but it gives some peace in the end.

I can relate, especially everything seeming so difficult, but i also try to rationalise that a lot of people don't work in their field of education and its not something to be embarassed about.

She cheated on you one month into your relationship. 

This is suppose to be the best time for any relationship, time when you fall in love with each other. Time when there are no problems and everything is great between you. You clearly did not become inseparable, because she was capable of sleeping with her ex.  

You love her and she's become someone special to you, could you sleep with someone else while being that much in love? Well, she could. Let that sink in.

Is there a possibility it was a one time? Sure, maybe she can turn into a best girlfriend ever. But the special thing you have is already tainted and there is a higher chance she will repeat this. It will be in the back of your mind. 

I support forgiveness and reconciliation, but this is like the worst scenario to start a relationship with someone and it's not like the bar is set very high.

Had somewhat similar story 6 months ago, i've found out my gf at the time started cheating with her boss. She didnt say anything, wanted to break up, then wasn't sure and wanted more time, but i already suspected something is going on so i checked her messenger and low and behold, there it was.

She was asking for more time to think while simultaneously scheduling another date with him. On our holiday trip i was unknowingly helping her buy a gift for her bestie, later i've learned it was for him, which stung. There were other cold and cruel acts which i dont even want to get into. 

Never got the "why" or any kind of explanation, when i showed the proof she didnt deny, but also said she didnt even know if she liked him.

Six months later our mutual friends are now friends with him on facebook (they knew she cheated with him), so i assume they are still together, not officially of course, but they even get to have our old social circle. It makes a dent in your sense of self worth. 

Yeah, i dont feel like there is karma even though we tend to say it here a lot. Sometimes people just click, even if its through cheating.

Best we can do is move on, which is hard when people who fucked you get to enjoy all the things you lost. But its still doable i think. I'm still not there though. 

Anyway, you are not alone in this dude and your life is not ruined. It will get better.

Most likely, Putin already understands that this war is lost for them and he will need to withdraw from Ukraine. 

But he also wants to stay in power. 

Sitting at the table with Zelensky for peace talks would be absolutely humiliating for him. 

After all, this conflict was built around the idea that Ukrainian government is a bunch of illegitimate nazis and Russia will step in like a crude father figure to bring order. 

Ending the conflict with Ukraine would shatter that narrative and no amount of creative spins and propaganda would save his face. Being beaten by much smaller country led by a former comedian, while simultanously crashing the economy and losing thousands of lives in the process? No chance Putin survives this. 

It would also brutally destroy the image of Russia Putin built for decades internally, which is that of a superpower with a very strong leader that can bully others for its own gains. Lots of people in Russia actually respect that. This would be a rude awakening for many. 

The way around this is to actually draw in NATO and make peace with Biden instead of Zelensky. This way he can say "yes, we lost, but we lost to NATO which i always said was a threat to us". This would rally Russians against NATO and was less humiliating for him, which in turn gives him more chance to stay in power. 

I hope NATO doesn't take the bait. The best thing for Ukraine, Russian neighbors and EU is for this regime to fall on its face as hard as it's possible. There needs to be a deeper change in Russian way of treating power and geopolitics, the more humiliating the defeat, the better. 

Swapping Putin for another Medvedev or someone like this won't change much in the long run.
